name: coherent-curve-steering-gain-v1
purpose: hold a more decisive steering request through visually coherent curves while preserving current-obstacle avoidance, steering slew and the existing high-speed longitudinal envelope

evidence.run_finding: The consumed seed11,17,21 runs all left the road after an outside obstacle pass into a continuing hairpin. Peak emitted steering was only0.173/0.196/0.218 and the final valid steering unwound to -0.027/+0.014/-0.012 at exactly the inherited0.07-per-frame slew, far below obstacle cap0.32 and global cap0.48.
evidence.interpretation: Raising only the cap cannot affect those traces. A bounded same-direction request gain can keep the emitted request above the0.07 slew-down trajectory for several frames without changing the slew itself. These runs are consumed and cryptographically unbound, so this is mechanism motivation rather than confirmation.
evidence.video_finding: The latest 4_7 videos finish all tracks and support coherent U-turn/hairpin sections as plausible use cases, but the earlier Track3 obstacle collision shows that globally increasing obstacle or inside bias is unsafe. Videos expose neither policy-camera frames nor actions and are not bound to this candidate.
evidence.physics_constraint: The existing curvature-conditioned target, strong-steer target44, compound target30 and steering-based throttle attenuation remain active so additional lateral request does not bypass the shared longitudinal/lateral force budget.

every current-obstacle steering/action/pass-side/urgency transition, including opposing avoidance
straight, translated-straight, clear-exit, missing-row and incoherent/S-curve steering
all target-speed, gas and brake formulas; only their already-existing steering-dependent safety gates may respond to the stronger request
obstacle targets47/40, obstacle+sweep>=6 target30 and miss-latch longitudinal behavior
lost-road behavior, observation/action interface, model.pt, official environment, DrQ, explicit-export and HAIC routes

static_and_synthetic: Bare state-dict routing selects only the candidate; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC routes remain unchanged.
Mirrored coherent curves produce symmetric requests and exactly the registered20-percent/0.06/0.48 envelope; repeated actions retain the inherited0.07 slew bound.
The exact1.5 far-row boundaries, gain-versus-increment intersection at abs(request)=0.30, cap, sign and missing-row boundaries are closed.

Current obstacle actions and all state are exactly equal to control, while the first obstacle-miss latch frame may apply the registered same-direction curve gain without changing its longitudinal action.
Reacquisition is immediately current-obstacle exact; opposite-direction S-curves, parallel offsets, aligned exits, road loss and reset never retain stale attack state.
Final _carry_steer_request equals the actual amplified preclip request, so strong-steer target44 and friction-aware gas attenuation remain active at exact0.28 plus/minus nextafter boundaries.
Randomized actions are finite/bounded, never overlap gas and brake, preserve current-obstacle actions exactly and differ in steering only under the registered gate.
Affected/local/submission contract tests and an isolated exact-file package smoke pass.

future_environment_gate.required_before_claim: After governance restoration, compare candidate and exact control on preregistered unused multi-track geometry seeds. Completion rate, DNF, collision and worst progress may not regress before lap time is considered.
future_environment_gate.objective: Hold speed through coherent curves by reducing premature steering release; source and synthetic validation cannot establish completion or lap-time improvement.

abort: Any runtime condition uses track id, seed, map identity, coordinate, time, progress or evaluation filename.
Any current-obstacle action/state differs from control, or any steering difference appears on straight, clear-exit, incoherent/opposite-sign or missing-row geometry.
Any steering delta exceeds0.07, candidate request exceeds0.48, final carry request does not match the actual amplified request, or a stale attack state survives reset/road loss.
Any target/gas/brake formula is explicitly changed, any action is non-finite/out of range, gas and brake overlap, package/interface gate fails, or relevant regression fails.
Any environment execution, training, submission, SOTA promotion or performance claim occurs while governance documents remain absent.
Any frozen environment/model/DrQ/active-study artifact, user video or root submission.zip changes.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
The competition website is inaccessible; the official participant repository remains available and unchanged.
Only source, synthetic, unit and isolated package validation is authorized.
